theme.description: A quiet forest. A distant castle. Every choice changes the path ahead.

start.title: Three paths beneath the leaves
start.description: The autumn forest parts before you. One trail is dim and overgrown, another glows in the afternoon light. Behind you, the road home is already fading.

shaded_path.title: A figure among the trees
shaded_path.description: The light thins beneath the branches. Ahead, a gnoll stands in the path. You could approach, ignore him, or hurry toward the brighter trail.

choices.label: Dart away toward the bright path

tree_gnoll.title: The gnoll blocks your way
tree_gnoll.description: The gnoll watches you carefully. He offers a riddle, but there may be another way past him. (Some encounters are rarer than others.)

riddle_success.title: The gnoll lets you pass
riddle_success.description: Your answer satisfies the gnoll. He steps aside, revealing three possible destinations. But the cave is not what it seems...

empty_cave.title: Something stirs in the dark
empty_cave.description: The cave is empty. Before you can turn back, another gnoll emerges from the shadows and crushes you beneath its weight.

puppy_cave.title: A tiny chorus of whimpers
puppy_cave.description: You overcome the gnoll and discover a hidden den. A litter of puppies huddles together in the warm straw. What will you do?

choices.label: Rescue the puppies and take them with you

after_puppies.title: The path continues
after_puppies.description: You leave the puppies undisturbed and step back into the autumn air. The castle rises to one side, while the river winds through the trees on the other.

choices.label: Make your way to the river

bright_path.title: Sunlight through the canopy
bright_path.description: The trees thin and golden light spills across the trail. You hear a river nearby and spot a strange plant growing beside the path.

choices.label: Dip your toes in the river
Bathe and follow the path onward

bathing.title: A place to catch your breath
bathing.description: Refreshed, you reach a clearing where the castle road branches away from a dark stretch of forest.

river.title: The river’s offerings
river.description: Clear water runs over smooth stones. A glimmer catches your eye beneath the surface. Nearby, a fish struggles and a turtle has become caught on a hook.

choices.label: Reach for the shiny golden pebble

castle.title: The castle doors stand open
castle.description: You arrive at the castle. From within, you hear footsteps, clattering dishes, and the restless sounds of horses in the stables. Where will you go?

perished.title: You have perished
perished.description: The forest has claimed another adventurer. Share the newsletter with a friend and return for another attempt after the cooldown.

basic.title: Simple but sufficient
basic.description: A little treasure, found by keeping your eyes open. Simple, but sufficient.

medium.title: Well-deserved
medium.description: A kind choice brought you a well-earned keepsake from the river.

good.title: Interesting!
good.description: A sweet reward for a bold little castle raid.

rare.title: Unique!
rare.description: You found the stables and earned a remarkable companion.

legendary.title: Holy smokes
legendary.description: The secret shadow route led you to a litter of puppies. You rescued them and uncovered the legendary reward!

map.label: The Autumn Castle
map.description: Unlocked: the first known region of the world
